payload.title: canon test filter runs whole suite
payload.body: pnpm --filter @cratylus/canon test -- test/command-veracity.test.ts runs all 37 canon test files, not the one named, and the suite needs a prior pnpm build and pnpm project to pass (harness-parity reads the renders). Seen while landing author-readmes; the one file passes alone via pnpm exec vitest run test/command-veracity.test.ts in packages/canon.
